name: Feature request

## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Motivation
Why would this feature be useful? What problem does it solve?

## 📝 Detailed Description
Provide a detailed description of how this feature should work.

## 🎨 UI/UX Considerations
If applicable, describe how this feature should look and feel:
- Where should it be placed in the interface?
- How should users interact with it?
- Any visual mockups or sketches?

## 🔧 Technical Considerations
Any technical aspects to consider:
- Performance implications
- Compatibility requirements
- Dependencies needed

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria
What needs to be implemented for this feature to be considered complete?
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 🎯 Priority
- [ ] Low - Nice to have, not urgent
- [ ] Medium - Would improve user experience
- [ ] High - Important for core functionality
- [ ] Critical - Essential for the project

## 📸 Mockups/Examples
If you have any mockups, sketches, or examples from other applications, please attach them here.

## 🤝 Implementation
Are you willing to work on this feature?
- [ ] Yes, I'd like to implement this
- [ ] Yes, I can help with implementation
- [ ] No, but I'd like to see it implemented
- [ ] I'm not sure

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, links, or references about the feature request here.
